reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for melatonin or any supplement. That one is for a doctor or dietitian, who can weigh it against your sleep, your health and anything else you take.

What I can say is that recovery runs mostly on the basics: a consistent bedtime and wake time, a dark and cool room, and enough total sleep. Most people find that does more for their lifting than anything in a bottle.

If your sleep has been poor, tell me what your week looks like and we can see whether your training load or schedule is part of it.
